                        At check-in they asked to reserve my credit card, even though I had already paid for the room and said I did not want a voucher.

                      3. Price paid

                      4. Register notes

                        Scandic Elmia provided a satisfactory overnight stay at a fair room price of SEK 1,107. Parking cost a further SEK 105, bringing the recorded total for the room and parking to SEK 1,212.

                        Parking was paid separately through Pair Parking’s website, where the parking receipt was also available. On this stay, the parking charge could not be included on the hotel receipt.

                        Owner stay report, 27 October 2026: at check-in the hotel asked to reserve the credit card, even though the room was already paid and no voucher was wanted.

                        The room price was reasonable. The additional parking cost and separate receipt should be taken into account when comparing alternatives, particularly for business travel. This stay does not qualify for the free-parking shortlist.

                        How the register works

                        Hotels join the free-parking list only after their own published information confirms free guest parking. Each parking entry links to its source and check date, with known registration requirements and paid alternatives explained. The Swedish Scandic audit covers 91 catalogue-linked properties. Norway’s 29 October review covers 81 catalogue properties: 78 have verified free/paid status and three remain outside this register pending charge confirmation. Other countries and chains remain partial. Norwegian Scandic audit and unresolved cases · Swedish Scandic audit · Other Nordic checks.

                        Green means confirmed free guest parking, the preferred option and default filter. Blue separates free parking known to require vehicle registration; unknown registration requirements remain labelled unknown. Yellow means “Easy parking”: parking costs money, but both payment at the hotel and inclusion on the hotel receipt are confirmed. Red means Avoid: paid parking with external payment, separate receipts or either fact unconfirmed, or a documented difficult-access report even when parking is free. An unconfirmed route stays labelled unknown; it is not a claim that hotel payment is impossible. Avoid is a parking preference, not a judgement of hotel quality. Payment at the hotel and inclusion on the hotel receipt are recorded separately.

                        The trip planner only suggests green hotels. It asks OpenStreetMap routing for driving times, suggests the closest green hotel to where you are going, and lists overnight stops only where they fall in the second half of the drive and add little time. Notes under each hotel are the register’s own records: owner reports, prices paid, notes and sources.

                        Stay reports and official hotel information are identified in each note. Personal names, booking references, card details and exact stay dates are excluded. Prices and parking arrangements can change; the recorded date keeps each entry in context.
